source_hypothesis.ns_upstream_probability_domain: computed inside ap_ns_process before floor_gain is applied to spectral output
source_hypothesis.vad_local_waveform_domain: post-NS and post-AGC waveform passed as samples to ap_vad_process
source_hypothesis.predicted_structure: ns_floor may change VAD local RMS/crest/noise-ratio evidence without changing NS upstream speech_probability

decision_contract.LOCAL_WAVEFORM_COUPLING_CONFIRMED_REVIEW: NS upstream probabilities remain numerically identical across floors, local post-NS/AGC waveforms differ, and at least one VAD probability or active trace follows waveform identity under cross-route substitution.
decision_contract.NO_OBSERVED_LOCAL_COUPLING_REVIEW_REQUIR: Inputs are valid and NS upstream probabilities remain invariant, but no VAD trace divergence is exercised on any fresh seed.
decision_contract.UPSTREAM_PROBABILITY_FLOOR_DEPENDENCE_RE: Changing only floor_gain changes NS upstream speech_probability, contradicting the source-level independence hypothesis.

reopening_rule: Any source candidate after I010 requires a separately reviewed hypothesis, new candidate identity, preregistered fresh authority, and cannot reuse public Full160 failures as candidate-value search data.
